import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    L = int(data[2])
    R = int(data[3])

    cells = N * M
    range_val = R - L + 1
    powered = pow(range_val, cells, MOD)

    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(powered)
    elif range_val % 2 == 0:
        print(powered * ((MOD + 1) // 2) % MOD)
    else:
        print((powered + 1) * ((MOD + 1) // 2) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
